meta.name: dot-ai-process-feature-request
meta.description: Process a feature request or response from another dot-ai project. Reads from tmp directory, implements/integrates, and writes response if needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动处理来自其他项目的功能请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在dot-ai项目间自动处理功能请求并集成代码。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically process feature requests from other projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically process feature requests and integrate code across dot-ai projects.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 读取其他 dot-ai 项目发来的功能请求或回复，然后帮你实现功能或整合信息，最后自动清理临时文件。
howto.when: 当 tmp 目录下有 feature-request.md 或 feature-response.md 文件时触发。

say.text: 处理 tmp 目录里的功能请求。
say.note: Claude 会读取请求并询问你是否继续。

say.text: 看看有没有其他项目给我的回复。
say.note: Claude 会读取回复并帮你整合。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to read feature requests or responses from other dot-ai projects, then implement or integrate the feature, and clean up temporary files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when feature-request.md or feature-response.md exists in the tmp directory.

say_en.text: Process the feature request in the tmp directory.
say_en.note: Claude reads the request and asks for confirmation.

say_en.text: Check if there's a response from another project.
say_en.note: Claude reads the response and helps integrate it.
